description: Retrieve a public water system’s reported enforcement actions or their violation associations. section actions returns source action codes, originator, calendar date and untrusted source comments; it does not imply every record is a federal order or a monetary penalty. section associations pages composite PWSID/violation/action keys and reported snapshot-quarter fields separately. Date filters mean inclusive enforcement date and apply only to actions. Pass violation_id to select related actions through composite association joins. Set stage true for a bounded analytical partition.

action_type.description: Exact enforcement-action type code; actions section only.

canvas_id.description: Explicit existing canvas capability; requires stage true.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this tool; retain exactly the original selectors.

date_from.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss lower date, normalized to its calendar day; violations/LCR require known endpoints to establish period overlap, actions use enforcement date and UCMR collection date.

date_to.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss upper date, normalized to its calendar day; either known period endpoint can establish overlap, while indeterminate overlap is excluded and reported.

limit.description: Inline items requested; values above the effective maximum 100 are clamped with a notice.

originator.description: Exact reported originator code; actions section only.

pwsid.description: Exact nine-character alphanumeric PWSID from sdwis_search_water_systems; unknown but shaped IDs return no matches.

record_cursor.description: Signed oversized-record pointer returned by this same tool; use with view text.

section.description: Actions by default; associations has independent paging and does not accept action/date predicates.

stage.description: Stage a bounded source partition with enabled DataCanvas.

stage_max_rows.description: Partition row request; above the effective cap 25000 is clamped with a notice.

view.description: Records by default; text reads an oversized record losslessly using record_cursor.

violation_id.description: Exact violation_id returned by sdwis_get_violations; always joined together with PWSID.

name: sdwis_get_enforcement_actions

pointer.description: Executable next steps for the canvas capability.

source_complete.description: Whether this staged partition contains the entire selected source.

effective_filters.description: Normalized effective selection; state_basis identifies legal-entity state matching.

encoding.description: Concatenated text is the exact serialized JSON record.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `selection_capacity_exhausted`: Live selections or retained source data reached the process capacity. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: Canvas admission, operation queue, table or row capacity is full. `invalid_selector`: Association section contains action-only selectors. `cursor_invalid`: Continuation expired or changed selectors. `source_changed`: EPA source metadata changed during retrieval. `upstream_contract_changed`: EPA action or association schema changed. `upstream_paging_changed`: EPA pages repeat without progress. `canvas_disabled`: Staging requested without an initialized canvas. `item_too_large`: One complete action/comment exceeds the inline wire budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: Whether the indicated continuation has more work.

items.description: Complete public source rows, never truncated strings.
Flat allowlisted source fields; null represents unknown source data.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation pointing at the first unconsumed item or source work.

offset.description: Unicode code-point offset of this chunk.

published_release.description: Publisher release label, distinct from HTTP modification and observation dates.

retrieved_at.description: HTTP retrieval time, not observation or snapshot time.

record_identity.description: Identity of the oversized record being read.

returned.description: Items in this response, not a total.

selection_partition.description: Delivered source position; membership-only work has no position.

final_partition.description: Final source partition when exhaustion is known; otherwise null.

selection_id.description: Stable identity of this source retrieval.

source_complete.description: All selected source rows are contained in this output or its current staged partition; false after earlier rows were delivered.

truncated.description: True when this inline preview omits retained or unfetched source rows; follow the exact continuation or live dataset.

title: Sdwis Get Enforcement Actions
